title: Business Architecture Strategy ↔ Principles Matrix
description: Many-to-many mapping between Business Architecture Strategy (BUS-STR) statements and Business Architecture Principles (BUS-PRN) — showing which principles operationalise which strategic intents.

meta.description: Maps each Business Architecture Strategy statement to the Architecture Principles that operationalise it.
purpose: Shows which principles exist to deliver which strategic intents, and surfaces strategies with no supporting principles
Supports impact analysis — if a strategy changes, which principles need review?
Provides traceability from strategic intent (the why) through to design guidance (the how)

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to (this file's $id).

relationships.description: Sparse list of required mappings between BUS-STR (columns) and BUS-PRN (rows). Presence of an entry means the principle is required to operationalise the strategy; absence means no required relationship.
